evals.prompt: Please write the Thai core plan for day 2 of my meteorology block for the supervisors.
evals.expected_output: One แผนการจัดการเรียนรู้ for block day 2, written in 20-thai-plans/ (the layout's Thai core plans location) on the plugin's Thai core plan template (the course has no template of its own). It follows the week 1, day 2 day plan: ขั้นนำ holds Rhythmic Time and the open-question recall of the monsoon storm; ขั้นสอน holds concept formation with the driving question board, the reflection, the practice and the convection tank as the new experience; ขั้นสรุป only closes and previews tomorrow's recall, without analysing the tank. Indicators ว 3.2 ม.6/10 (and others the day serves) verbatim; K-P-A objectives unpacked from them with official skill and attitude names; rubrics rewritten for science; ปีการศึกษา 2569; scoring tables blank; reflection named as assessment as learning without a score. The Waldorf plans are untouched.
expectations: Exactly one Thai core plan was written, inside 20-thai-plans/, for block day 2 (week 1, day 2); no plans for other days were written
The plan follows the plugin's Thai core plan form: its numbered sections 1 to 9 are present and Section 7 has the three stage headings ขั้นนำเข้าสู่บทเรียน, ขั้นสอน/ขั้นจัดกิจกรรม and ขั้นสรุป
ขั้นนำ (the introduction stage) holds the rhythmic opening and the recall of yesterday's monsoon storm through open questions; it contains no quiz or test

ขั้นสอน (the teaching stage) holds, in the day plan's order: concept formation from the storm (students' own positions or sketch models compared by the class, questions onto the driving question board), the reflection, the practice, and the convection tank as the day's new experience
ขั้นสรุป (the conclusion stage) does not explain, discuss or analyse the convection tank; it closes the lesson and says that tomorrow's recall starts from the tank
Thai indicators appear with their official codes and Thai wording verbatim, including ว 3.2 ม.6/10 as exactly: อธิบายการหมุนเวียนของอากาศตามเขตละติจูด และผลที่มีต่อภูมิอากาศ

Objectives are split into K, P and A; the P objectives use official Thai skill names (such as การสังเกต or การสร้างแบบจำลอง) and the A objectives use official names from the 8 คุณลักษณะอันพึงประสงค์ or the Thai scientific attitudes (such as ความใจกว้าง or ความอยากรู้อยากเห็น)
Every K, P and A objective has a matching row in the measurement table, and the 4-level rubrics describe this science lesson's tasks (not the template's maths example about แบบฝึกทักษะ percentages)
The academic year is given as the Buddhist-era ปีการศึกษา 2569
The student scoring tables (แบบบันทึกคะแนน / แบบบันทึกการประเมินผล) have no student names and no scores filled in, and the post-teaching results (บันทึกผลหลังการสอน) are left blank
The reflection is named as assessment as learning (or self-assessment) in the measurement section without a score
The Waldorf block plan, week plans and day plans are unchanged
No student names appear anywhere

evals.prompt: Now the Thai core plan for day 3, please.
evals.expected_output: One Thai core plan for block day 3 in 20-thai-plans/. The day plan for day 3 has two problems the skill reports in its reply: the sea-breeze box (today's new experience) is explained the same day with a marked worksheet and a class discussion at the close, which breaks the two-day rhythm; and its parts add up to 120 minutes against a 100-minute session. The Thai core plan does not carry the same-day analysis into ขั้นสรุป, and the skill does not edit the Waldorf day plan without being asked; it offers to fix it.
expectations: Exactly one Thai core plan was written, inside 20-thai-plans/, for block day 3
ขั้นนำ holds the open-question recall of yesterday's convection tank
ขั้นสรุป does not explain, discuss or analyse the sea-breeze box (the smoke's movement); it closes the lesson and previews tomorrow's recall

The reply reports that the day 3 day plan explains or discusses the sea-breeze box on the same day it is first experienced (the worksheet and the closing discussion), and says why this conflicts with the overnight rhythm
The reply reports that the day 3 day plan's timings add up to more than the 100-minute session (120 minutes)
The reply offers to fix the day plan (or asks how the teacher wants it fixed) rather than having silently changed it, and the day plan file is unchanged
The Thai core plan names no marked or scored test of the sea-breeze box on day 3, and states the measurement methods for K, P and A
Thai indicators appear with their official codes and Thai wording verbatim
The academic year is given as ปีการศึกษา 2569, and the scoring tables carry no student names or scores
No student names appear anywhere

evals.prompt: Please write the Thai core plans for unit 1 of Science Practice (electric circuits) for the supervisors.
evals.expected_output: Two แผนการจัดการเรียนรู้ in 30-thai-plans/, one per 5E cycle of unit 1 (no plan per session and no Waldorf plans), on the plugin's form. Each plan's stages follow its own cycle plan's stated mapping: cycle 1 has Engage in ขั้นนำ, Explore, Explain, the hinge question and Elaborate in ขั้นสอน, and the students' summary and exit slip in ขั้นสรุป; cycle 2 has retrieval practice and Engage in ขั้นนำ, Explore, Explain and Elaborate in ขั้นสอน, and Evaluate with the exit slip in ขั้นสรุป. Time is the cycle's sessions added up (250 minutes = 4 ชั่วโมง 10 นาที; 200 minutes = 3 ชั่วโมง 20 นาที). Indicators verbatim; retrieval practice, hinge question and exit slips not scored. The reply reports that session 5's timings add up to 110 minutes against a 100-minute session and offers to fix the cycle plan without changing it.
expectations: Exactly two Thai core plans were written inside 30-thai-plans/, one for cycle 1 (measuring a circuit) and one for cycle 2 (Ohm's law), and no plans per session

Each plan's Section 7 names the 5E phases (in English or by Thai names such as ขั้นสร้างความสนใจ, ขั้นสำรวจและค้นหา, ขั้นอธิบายและลงข้อสรุป, ขั้นขยายความรู้, ขั้นประเมิน) under the three stage headings
In the cycle 1 plan, ขั้นนำ holds Engage (the two bulbs), ขั้นสอน holds Explore, Explain, the hinge question and Elaborate, and ขั้นสรุป holds the students' own summary and the exit slip

In the cycle 2 plan, ขั้นนำ holds the retrieval practice and Engage (the prediction challenge), ขั้นสอน holds Explore, Explain and Elaborate, and ขั้นสรุป holds Evaluate (the practical task on the unknown resistor) and the exit slip
The cycle 1 plan's time is 250 minutes (4 ชั่วโมง 10 นาที) and the cycle 2 plan's time is 200 minutes (3 ชั่วโมง 20 นาที), or the plans give each session's length so that they add up to these
The Thai indicators appear with their codes and Thai wording verbatim, including ว 2.3 ม.3/3 as exactly: ใช้โวลต์มิเตอร์ แอมมิเตอร์ในการวัดปริมาณทางไฟฟ้า
Retrieval practice, the hinge question and the exit slips are not scored in the measurement section or the scoring tables; the exit slips are named as assessment as learning
The reply reports that session 5 adds up to 110 minutes against its 100-minute length, and the cycle plan files are unchanged
No Waldorf block plan, week plan or day plan was written
The class level is ม.3, the academic year is ปีการศึกษา 2569, and the scoring tables carry no student names or scores
No student names appear anywhere
